Strings.component_center.download.title: Install component
Strings.component_center.download.method.ClientD: Download on this device and upload
Strings.component_center.download.manual_hint: After downloading, choose a local or server file source, select the package and enter its version, then install.
Strings.component_center.download.empty: No versions found. Refresh or select a file and enter its version.
Strings.component_center.download.timeout: Loading versions timed out. Retry or select an existing package.
Strings.component_center.download.rate_limited: GitHub API requests were rate limited or denied. Retry later.
Strings.component_center.download.network_failed: Cannot connect to the official release source. Check the network and retry.
Strings.component_center.download.unsupported: Official downloads do not support this server platform or architecture.
Strings.component_center.download.index_unavaila: The server could not load the official version list. Check the network and retry.
Strings.component_center.download.permission_den: You do not have permission to read the version list.
Strings.component_center.download.state_unavaila: Cannot verify component state. Refresh the component state and retry.
Strings.component_center.download.failed: Could not load versions. Retry or select an existing package and enter its version.
Strings.component_center.package.no_configured_c: The server’s configured APT sources have no installable package for this component. Configure a source on the server and retry; Component Center does not add sources automatically.
Strings.component_center.package.external_change: Verified external package change: {0} → {1}. Management authorization remains; this is not a success receipt for the original installation.
Strings.component_center.package.identity_unveri: Installed package files, architecture or service ownership could not be verified. Changes and registration are unavailable.
Strings.component_center.package.register_confir: Register package {1} on host {0} (version {2}, architecture {3}, executable SHA-256 {4})? This authorizes package lifecycle management without reinstalling, taking over application configuration or changing service state.
Strings.component_center.package.acknowledge_con: Confirm the current installation of {1} on host {0} (version {2}, architecture {3}, executable SHA-256 {4})? The original management authorization is retained and only this verified identity becomes the recorded version. Nothing is reinstalled, application configuration is not taken over and service state is not changed.
Strings.component_center.native.manager_hint: Only detected, connected managers are listed. APT uses authorized sources; dpkg removal retains configuration and data.
Strings.component_center.native.hint: Check the host sources and versions, then approve the plan before execution.
Strings.component_center.native.hint.package: The host package manager provides available versions. The source and changes are checked before installation, update, or removal. Configuration and data are retained on removal.
Strings.component_center.native.hint.download: One pinned archive is downloaded from a trusted release source and its SHA-256 verified. The install is recorded in the same ledger; this platform never goes through a distribution package manager.
This host: no install method is available for this component on this platform
Strings.component_center.native.platform_unknown: The host platform is not confirmed yet, so this host's install method is unknown. Refresh the state.
Strings.component_center.native.install_only: On this platform only installation is connected for the direct download; update and uninstall are not part of this panel yet.
Strings.component_center.native.no_update: No higher version is available from the current package source.
Strings.component_center.native.ownership_requir: This installation has not been brought under component management. Automatic updates and removal are unavailable.
Strings.component_center.task_dialog.close_hint: Closing preserves drafts. Submitted tasks continue in the background.
Strings.component_center.task_dialog.title: Component tasks
Strings.component_center.task_dialog.scope: For predefined scenarios and supported component operations. Select a scenario or component, preview the plan, then approve execution.
Strings.component_center.git.integration: Existing platform installer and operation ledger
Strings.component_center.component.git.descripti: Host Git engine; installation and operation history are managed in Component Center.
Strings.component_center.git.hint: Shows the Git executable and version already present on this Windows host. Component Center has no Windows Git installer yet: install with winget or the official Git for Windows package, then refresh here to re-check.
Strings.component_center.git.confirm: Install Git on the current Linux host using existing package sources and authorization checks? Frozen version plans and multi-version updates are unavailable.
Strings.component_center.inspection_capacity: The server has reached its saved-plan limit. Ask the server administrator to review retained records.
Strings.component_center.inspection_storage_fail: The server could not save the inspection result. Ask the server administrator to check plan storage.
Strings.component_center.inspection_no_catalog: Installation state checked. No source catalog is loaded, so the catalog was not checked. Select a source and refresh to check it.
Strings.component_center.inspect_hint: Read the component installation state and selected source catalog to identify issues.
Strings.component_center.inspection_changed: State has changed. Refresh the component and check again.
Strings.component_center.inspection_complete: Check complete. Results reflect the state at the time of inspection.
Strings.component_center.inspection_denied: Permission to read component state was denied.
Strings.component_center.inspection_failed: The check failed. Refresh and try again.
Strings.component_center.persistence_hint: Drafts are saved on this device. Preview replans and requests approval after restart.
Strings.component_center.persistence_failed: Draft storage could not be read or saved. Current selections remain in this process only; check local storage and retry.
Manage host components, trusted versions and recovery.
Strings.component_center.required_message: The required component is missing on this host. Confirm to open Component Center. Opening it does not install anything.
Strings.component_center.staged: Added to pending changes; nothing has been installed or authorized.
Strings.component_center.draft_hint: Selections only edit a local draft. Preview replans on the host.
Strings.component_center.close_message: Keep to reopen on this server. Discard only clears the draft; it does not uninstall components.
Strings.component_center.draft_conflict: This component has a different pending change. Remove it before choosing another.
Strings.component_center.draft_stale: The host, installation identity or target changed. Select the change again.
Strings.component_center.host_mismatch: The target host differs from the current connection. Connect to it in Server Center first.
Strings.component_center.located: Located sing-box. No change was selected or installation started.
Strings.component_center.source_select: The installed source could not be uniquely matched. Explicitly select a source and review its identity.
Strings.component_center.source_ambiguous: The active release appears in multiple sources. Explicitly select a source.
Strings.component_center.availability.Unknown: The state of {1}, required by {0}, could not be confirmed. Check the connection and retry. An unknown state never triggers installation.
Strings.component_center.availability.package_re: {0} requires a compatible version of {1}. Open App Installer to install or repair the dependency.
Strings.component_center.availability.module_rep: {0} requires an available server module {1}. Open Component Center to check the module.
Strings.component_center.availability.Missing: {0} requires {1}, which is not installed on this host. Open Component Center to install it, then open the application again.
Strings.component_center.availability.External: An external installation of {1} was detected. View ownership in Component Center; it will not be taken over automatically.
Strings.component_center.availability.Recovery: {1} has a transaction requiring recovery. Recover it in Component Center before opening the application.
Strings.component_center.availability.Busy: A task for {1} is already running. View progress in Component Center before opening the application.
Strings.component_center.availability.NoPermissi: You do not have permission to read the dependency state of {0}. Ask an administrator.
Strings.component_center.notice.component_busy: A component task is already running. View its progress in Tasks and recovery.
Strings.component_center.dependency.title: Component dependencies
Strings.component_center.dependency.hint: Install, update, repair, rollback and removal happen only in Component Center. This area shows the current host state; a stopped service is not a missing component and its business console still opens.
Strings.component_center.dependency.unavailable: The component dependency cannot be read: sign in to a server that supports host components.
Strings.component_center.dependency.no_permissio: No permission to read component state. Grant it, then choose Check dependencies again.
Strings.component_center.dependency.read_failed: The component state could not be read. Check the connection and retry.
Strings.component_center.ready_only_hint: Filter desktop and application lists. Component Center, Settings and recovery remain available. Shortcuts still check dependencies on the current host.
Strings.component_center.observation_unknown: Installation state has not been observed. Refresh the current host.
Strings.component_center.evidence_commit: Original operation commit: state revision {0}, measured version {1}, active release {2}.
Strings.component_center.evidence_commit_missing: No successful commit evidence was saved for the original operation; a success receipt alone cannot prove recovery is complete.
Strings.component_center.updates_unknown: Updates cannot be determined yet. Select a source and refresh its catalog in Release sources; a failed query or expired catalog cannot establish that this is the latest version.
Strings.component_center.updates_requires_manage: Only managed installations support update checks. Check installation state and ownership in All components.
Strings.component_center.no_updates: No confirmed newer stable release is available in this catalog. Check catalog freshness in Release sources.
Strings.component_center.explicit_action: The component is installed. Use an explicit update, repair, rollback or removal action.
Strings.component_center.select_version: Read host state and select a trusted source and an exact version first.
Strings.component_center.selection_hint: Checkboxes edit pending changes. Installation state and version are shown separately.
Strings.component_center.workload_hint: A workload references components; it is not a separate package. Selecting requirements only stages local intent.
Strings.component_center.component_unknown: This component is absent from the catalog and cannot be planned.
Strings.component_center.change_plan_ready: The server has frozen this proposal. It has not been approved or executed.
Strings.component_center.task_confirm_hint: Review every action, target version, data impact and digest below. Execution uses this exact plan.
Strings.component_center.task_service_impact: The service may be stopped or restarted.
Strings.component_center.task_credentials: Verify a host administrator for this plan only.
Strings.component_center.task_unchecked: No task result has been checked.
Strings.component_center.task_accepted: Task accepted. Progress and final outcome come from the server.
Strings.component_center.task_not_started: Approval has no accepted run yet. Continue explicitly to start it.
Strings.component_center.task_approval_unavailab: Approval is expired or revoked. Create a fresh plan.
Strings.component_center.task_reference_failed: Task references could not be saved or read. No new start is submitted without durable storage.
Strings.component_center.task_request_failed: The task request failed or the session changed. Read status before retrying.
Strings.component_center.task_state.Cancelling: Cancellation requested; waiting for the actual outcome
Strings.component_center.task_recovery_unresolve: The original receipt and current host state do not yet prove the result. Resolve host recovery and check again. No steps were executed again.
Strings.component_center.task_recovery_checked: The original receipt and current host state confirm the result. No steps were executed again.
Strings.component_center.task_recovery_read_hint: Read the original operation's host recovery state before choosing an action.
Strings.component_center.task_recovery_summary: Recovery operation: {0}; recorded requests: {1}. An action response does not prove recovery. Recheck the result.
Strings.component_center.task_recovery_effect.Re: Retry only the original transaction's compensation to restore the previous program, configuration and service. This does not install again or resume remaining steps.
Strings.component_center.task_recovery_effect.Em: Stop the service associated with this pending transaction. Business connections will be interrupted. The transaction's uncertain result remains unresolved.
Strings.component_center.task_recovery_effect.Cl: Close the original transaction after compensation failed and the service stopped. Resources may still need manual attention. This does not mean recovery succeeded.
Strings.component_center.task_recovery_response: The recovery action response was recorded. Recheck the task using the host receipt.
Strings.component_center.task_recovery_response_: The original recovery request is recorded, but its response is unknown. The host was not called again. Read the details and recheck the result.
Strings.component_center.recovery_service_unknow: Service state is unknown. Refresh recovery details.
Strings.component_center.recovery_attempt_unknow: Response unknown. Check the host result.
Strings.component_center.recovery_attempt_record: The host responded. Recheck the task result.
Strings.component_center.recovery_attempt_failed: The recovery action did not complete. Read the details again.
Strings.component_center.result_planned_delete: Frozen plan: delete business data. Failure, cancellation or recovery does not prove deletion.
Strings.component_center.result_planned_preserve: Frozen plan: preserve business data. This view does not provide per-resource retention evidence.
Strings.component_center.result_problem: This step could not be confirmed complete. Read the original operation and recovery details. Raw server diagnostics are not displayed here.
Strings.component_center.result_summary: Succeeded {0} · No change {1} · Failed {2} · Skipped {3} · Cancelled {4} · Compensated {5} · Recovery {6}
Strings.component_center.result_evidence_hint: Step states come from the host task record. Planned effects do not replace resource observations. Recovery results still require reconciliation.
Strings.component_center.evidence_missing: No attributable host observation was available at that time.
Strings.component_center.evidence_empty: No host reconciliation evidence has been saved for this task.
Strings.component_center.evidence_history_hint: These are historical task records. Reading does not refresh the host or execute recovery. Resource retention still requires domain evidence.
Strings.component_center.evidence_receipt.Unknow: No matching host receipt was available at that time.
Strings.component_center.integration_runtime_onl: This component's version is managed on the runtime page below and does not enter a batch draft yet.
Strings.component_center.integration_application: Installation still happens inside the owning application; this center only lists the catalog and planned sources.
Strings.component_center.not_integrated_title: This component is not connected to the component center yet
Strings.component_center.not_integrated_message: Installing, updating and removing {0} still happens on that application's own page.
Strings.component_center.not_integrated_scope: The center shows only the catalog entry, install sources and owning application, and offers no install button. These actions move here once the adapter lands.
Strings.component_center.change_plan_hint: Previewing rereads host state and freezes the exact version; approval and execution are separate steps.
Strings.component_center.component.sing-box.desc: Runtime core of Proxy Server: inbounds, principals and configuration publishing.
Strings.component_center.component.mihomo.descri: Runtime core of Proxy Manager: subscription profiles, traffic entry points and network recovery.
Strings.component_center.component.nginx.descrip: Reverse proxy used by the Web Server Manager.
Strings.component_center.component.squid.descrip: HTTP/CONNECT proxy service used by the Squid gateway.
Strings.component_center.component.docker.descri: Container engine required by the Docker Manager.
Strings.component_center.component.samba.descrip: SMB file sharing service used by File Services.
Strings.component_center.observation.title: Host facts
Strings.component_center.observation.hint: Read-only facts the owning application already reports. This panel never installs, plans or approves anything.
Strings.component_center.observation.complete: Read; the facts come from the owning application's API.
Strings.component_center.observation.failed: The host state could not be read. Check the connection and retry.
Strings.component_center.observation.managed_not: The Web Server Manager owns this component as an instance; the install source depends on the platform.
Strings.component_center.observation.candidate_n: A host Nginx was found but is not integrated with the Web Server Manager yet.
Strings.component_center.observation.none: No Nginx managed by RelaxKonOS, and none available to integrate, was found.
Strings.component_center.package.title: Install source freeze
Strings.component_center.package.hint: Resolves the candidate through the install mode this host actually uses: a distribution package comes from the host package manager with its exact version, repository and digest; a managed archive comes from the managed runtime catalog. Resolution only reads facts and installs nothing.
Strings.component_center.package.unresolved: Not checked yet, or no installation method is available
Strings.component_center.package.failed: Could not check versions. Please try again.
Strings.component_center.package.denied: This account may not install the component
Strings.component_center.package.unsupported: This host does not register the component
Strings.component_center.package.problem.executi: this build has no install transaction for that source yet
Strings.component_center.package.problem.unresol: No version is available from this source
Strings.component_center.package.problem.index_u: the package index could not be read
Strings.component_center.package.problem.version: The selected version no longer matches the available version
Strings.component_center.package.problem.already: already installed as a managed component
Strings.component_center.package.problem.revisio: Host state changed. Check versions again.
Strings.component_center.package.problem.platfor: this platform does not support that install mode
Strings.component_center.package.problem.source_: the requested install mode does not match this platform
Strings.component_center.package.problem.unknown: the host does not register this component
Strings.component_center.package.problem.package: the host now resolves a different package than the frozen identity; check the version again
Strings.component_center.package.problem.install: the install transaction did not finish; the package manager owns whatever it left behind. See the server diagnostics
the install reported success but the host measured a different version
Strings.component_center.package.problem.rollbac: a package transaction has no supported rollback; this result is informational
Strings.component_center.package.problem.confirm: installing activates a service, so it must be confirmed first
Strings.component_center.package.problem.executi: this change was only frozen and never submitted for execution
Strings.component_center.docker.note: Reads the Docker manager Engine API only. Permissions, connectivity or service state can make it unavailable; this does not prove absence or managed ownership and does not enable component installation.
Strings.component_center.domain.squid_note: Reads Squid domain status only; no executable version is reported. Managed configuration does not prove package ownership or authorize component installation.
Strings.component_center.domain.frpc_note: Reads the frpc executable only, not frps installation. Missing or invalid executables remain unknown and do not display retained versions.
Strings.component_center.domain.frps_note: Observes frps service state only. Saved, stopped or absent configuration does not prove executable installation. Version and executable ownership remain unverified.
Strings.component_center.component.frpc.descript: Tunnel client executable, observed separately from frps.
Strings.component_center.component.frps.descript: Tunnel server; configuration state does not prove executable version.
Strings.component_center.package.problem.host_po: The host has no approved upstream repository, signing key or access policy for this component yet. A host administrator must configure them first; resolving a plan never adds trust or expands access.
Strings.component_center.package.refresh_confirm: Refresh the host-approved package indexes for {0}. This adds no repositories, changes no signing keys and installs or upgrades no software. Continue?
Strings.permission.server.components.read.descri: View component installation state, approved versions and operation records.
Strings.permission.server.components.manage.desc: Plan and submit authorized component installations and recovery actions.
Strings.component_center.download.intro: Choose a package source, confirm the version, then install.
Strings.component_center.download.file_hint: Choose a package matching the server OS and architecture, and enter the file’s actual version.
Strings.component_center.download.file_failed: Could not select or upload the file. Try again.
Strings.component_center.component.tailscale.des: Install, update and remove Tailscale using official system installers while retaining data.
Strings.component_center.package.tailscale_sourc: Enable the Tailscale Inc. stable signed repository at https://pkgs.tailscale.com/stable/ for this host distribution. Signing key fingerprint: 2596 A99E AAB3 3821 893C 0A79 458C A832 957F 5868. Conflicting existing trust is refused. This step configures the source and refreshes indexes without installing software. Continue?
Strings.component_center.native.msi_hint: Install and update using official signed Tailscale MSI packages. Removal retains login and configuration data. Service restarts may interrupt remote connections.
Strings.component_center.sources.validity: Maximum catalog validity (seconds, at most 31 days)
Strings.component_center.sources.title: Catalog sources
Strings.component_center.sources.scope: Sources are saved on this desktop. Trusting a source does not authorize changes to the connected server.
Strings.component_center.sources.local: The bundled local catalog remains available offline. Remote sources are optional.
Strings.component_center.sources.name: Display name
Strings.component_center.sources.provider_scope: Allow only the installers this publisher needs. Every installation still requires package review and the applicable system permissions.
Strings.component_center.sources.private_hint: Only grant a specific private address range and port when this source needs them. Loopback, link-local and metadata addresses remain blocked.
Strings.component_center.sources.review_notice: Check the publisher, URL, key fingerprints and allowed installers. Signed packages still require review; a signature does not make code safe.
Strings.component_center.sources.invalid: The source policy is invalid. Check the HTTPS URL, publisher, public key and installer selection.
Strings.component_center.sources.approved: Source policy approved. Refresh to verify its signed catalog.
Strings.component_center.sources.approval_failed: The policy could not be approved. Its identity, key history or saved state may have changed.
Strings.component_center.sources.disabled: Source disabled. Installed applications and trust history are retained.
Strings.component_center.sources.removed: Source removed. Installed applications, rollback protection and revocations are retained.
Strings.component_center.sources.refreshed: Signed catalog verified and saved. No application was installed.
Strings.component_center.sources.refresh_failed: Could not refresh the source. Previously accepted information is retained; check its expiry and source status.
Strings.component_center.sources.state_failed: The source trust store is unavailable or needs recovery. Close other clients, check the current user's directory access, then restart the client. Remote installation is blocked; bundled components remain available. Do not delete trust history.
Strings.component_center.sources.complex_policy: This policy contains multiple keys or private networks. Review all entries with the deployment tools before replacing it.
Strings.component_center.sources.trust.user-trus: Publisher key explicitly trusted by this user
Strings.component_center.desktop.hint: Install on this desktop. Review the package and requested permissions before installing.
Strings.component_center.desktop.failed: The local catalog package could not be prepared.
Strings.server_modules.title: Server modules
Strings.server_modules.summary: Bundled and independently installed modules on this server. Enablement, residency policy and package changes are prepared as frozen plans and submitted only after confirmation; restart effects are called out.
Strings.server_modules.read_only: This account has no server-module management permission, and the server refused every management action. Module state, dependencies and residency facts remain visible.
Strings.server_modules.waiting: Waiting to reconnect and verify the original operation…
Strings.server_modules.unsubmitted: Not submitted; review the original plan before retrying.
Strings.server_modules.recovery_mode: The server is in recovery mode. Business modules are stopped. Preview restoring the complete bundled set, then leave recovery mode and restart normally.
Strings.server_modules.package_versions: Installed versions for the selected module
Strings.server_modules.packages_unavailable: The server did not return module package installation facts.
Strings.server_modules.package_plan_ready: Package verified. Review the frozen plan, then confirm.
Strings.server_modules.package_installed_restart: Installed. Restart the server to verify the package operation.
Strings.server_modules.package_rolled_back: Rollback recorded. Restart the server to verify.
Strings.server_modules.store_refresh_none: No source has a refresh URI.
Strings.server_modules.consent_summary: Select a module and review one declared action and target. Until expiry, that module can run this action without another prompt. File write binds the exact content digest; file deletion, data backup/delete, package removal and credential rotation still require explicit confirmation. Updates or trust/policy changes invalidate the permission. Host administrators only.
Strings.server_modules.consent_target: Exact target declared by the module
Strings.server_modules.list.title: Module catalog
Strings.server_modules.list.check_hint: Checked modules become the target set for enable, disable and wake actions
Strings.server_modules.list.empty: The server did not return a module list.
Strings.server_modules.select_hint: Click a module to see its identity, runtime state, dependencies and previewable actions. Check several modules to change them as one set.
Strings.server_modules.detail.runtime_hint: A dormant module is still installed and enabled; it wakes on the next business request.
Strings.server_modules.detail.actions_hint: Every action prepares a frozen plan and submits only after confirmation. Blocked or unwired actions state their reason.
Strings.server_modules.residency.disabled: The module is disabled and has no load state.
Strings.server_modules.residency.unknown: The server did not report residency for this module.
Strings.server_modules.action.admission_unknown: The server did not return admission for this action.
Strings.server_modules.action.busy: Another operation is running; wait for it to finish.
Strings.server_modules.action.session_changed: The login changed; read the module facts again.
Strings.server_modules.action.select_first: Select a module on the left first.
Strings.server_modules.action.already_enabled: The selected modules are already enabled.
Strings.server_modules.action.already_disabled: The selected modules are already disabled.
Strings.server_modules.action.already_loaded: The selected modules are already loaded.
Strings.server_modules.action.read_only: This account has no management permission; these actions cannot be submitted.
Strings.server_modules.action.enable_hint: Prepare a frozen plan to enable the selected modules; it takes effect after a server restart.
Strings.server_modules.action.disable_hint: Prepare a disable plan; enabled dependents or unfinished work block submission.
Strings.server_modules.action.wake_hint: Prepare a wake plan; it does not install, enable or restart a module.
Strings.server_modules.action.sleep_hint: Try releasing memory; active connections or background work block it.
Strings.server_modules.action.policy_hint: Prepare a residency policy change; it takes effect after a server restart.
Strings.server_modules.policy_hint: Submitting writes the desired policy; the effective policy updates after a restart.
Strings.server_modules.plan.title: Change plan awaiting confirmation
Strings.server_modules.plan.hint: Review the target, diff and blockers, then submit the original plan. Expired or blocked plans cannot be submitted.
Strings.server_modules.operation.title: Recent operations
Strings.server_modules.health.title: Module health
Strings.server_modules.health.hint: A read-only check; it does not wake modules or change the enabled set.
Strings.server_modules.health.not_checked: Module health has not been checked.
Strings.server_modules.credentials.title: Administrator credentials
Strings.server_modules.credentials.hint: Privilege confirmation and standing background permissions share these credentials. They are used only for the submission and are not stored.
Strings.server_modules.privilege_hint: Load a plan ID to review the module, version, target and effects. Approval requires administrator credentials.
Strings.server_modules.packages_hint: Independently installed module packages. Bundled modules ship with the server and cannot be installed or removed here.
Strings.server_modules.package_versions_hint: Choose a version to roll back to; the active version cannot be a target.
Strings.server_modules.package_no_versions: No installed versions for this module.
Strings.server_modules.package_plan.title: Package plan awaiting confirmation
Strings.server_modules.package_plan.hint: Review the module, version, publisher, runtime and declared privileges before confirming.
Strings.server_modules.store_hint: Search and install module packages from accepted sources; source state and catalog revision are shown separately.
Strings.server_modules.store_first_run: Refresh catalogs to read the accepted sources, then search for module packages. Installing still prepares a frozen plan that must be confirmed.
Strings.server_modules.store_search_hint: Search to list accepted releases here; selecting one shows its details and the install action.
Strings.server_modules.store_unavailable: Accepted sources could not be read.
Strings.server_modules.problem.module_forbidden: This account has no server-module management permission.
Strings.server_modules.problem.module_configurat: Module enablement is controlled by deployment configuration and cannot be changed here.
Strings.server_modules.problem.module_recovery_m: The server is in recovery mode; only restoring the module set is allowed.
Strings.server_modules.problem.module_recovery_b: The module still has unfinished recovery work.
Strings.server_modules.problem.module_active_wor: The module still has active connections or background work.
Strings.server_modules.problem.module_policy_kee: The residency policy requires this module to stay loaded.
Strings.server_modules.problem.module_resident_w: This module must remain resident. Background work stays tracked through completion or recovery confirmation.
Strings.server_modules.problem.module_resident_d: Another loaded module depends on this module.
Strings.server_modules.problem.module_pending_di: The module will be disabled after a restart.
Strings.server_modules.problem.module_desktop_de: A desktop application still needs this module. Uninstall or update the application on the device where it was installed, then try again.
Strings.server_modules.problem.module_dependency: An enabled module depends on it; disable the dependents first.
Strings.server_modules.problem.module_action_uns: The server does not support this action.
Strings.server_modules.problem.module_not_found: The server does not have this module.
Strings.server_modules.problem.module_state_unav: The server-module state could not be read.
Strings.server_modules.problem.module_revision_c: Another operation changed the module configuration; read it again before previewing.
Strings.server_modules.problem.module_plan_expir: The plan expired; prepare it again.
Strings.server_modules.problem.module_server_mis: The plan belongs to another server.
Strings.server_modules.problem.module_effective_: The operation finished, but the effective set does not match the plan.
Strings.server_modules.problem.module_response_i: The server response does not match the plan.
Strings.server_modules.problem.module_reference_: This session has no plan reference, so it cannot submit.
Strings.server_modules.problem.module_operation_: The server interrupted the operation; verify the result.
Strings.server_modules.problem.module_idempotenc: The same request was used for different content; prepare a new plan.
Strings.server_modules.problem.module_privilege_: The privilege plan was not found.

Strings.server_modules.problem.module_session_ch: The login changed; read the facts again.
Strings.server_modules.problem.module_host_code_: Confirm trust for this exact package before starting the module.
